Hi Sue —

Thanks for the clear list. We discussed internally and are proposing two concrete, numeric options for Healthlytics. I’ve attached a short pricing matrix and an updated SOW for pilot terms. High level:

Option A — Anchor model (fastest ramp to production)
- Platform fee: $420k/year (list $500k) — 16% year-1 onboarding concession
- Operator licenses: included for 3 primary DCs (Chicago, us-east, eu-west) for pilot; additional edge site billed at per-site rate
- Support slab: Standard (SLA: sev1 response <1 hour, sev2 <4 hours) included. 24x7 on-call uplift: $8k/month (optional).
- Observability addon: $48k/year (list $80k) with Year-1 pilot discount of 40% and tiered retention (30/90/365) available.

Option B — Blended model (platform fee offset by node commit)
- Platform fee: $300k/year (reduced) + committed node-hours: 2.5M node-hours/year
- Credit schedule: for each 250k node-hours above 1.5M we apply a $15k credit against platform fee (applies for Year 1 only)
- Support slab: Enhanced (SLA: sev1 response <30 minutes, sev2 <2 hours) included for blended customers; 24x7 on-call uplift: $6k/month when purchased with blended model.
- Observability addon: $60k/year with Year-1 bundled discount to $36k. Token-level cost export included as part of the add-on.

We are comfortable committing to an amortized invoicing schedule for the platform fee tied to the committed node-hours for Option B; finance has okayed monthly invoice draws provided the credit schedule is documented in the SOW and we have a minimum usage floor.

Attached: privdeploy_pricing_matrix.xlsx, Healthlytics_SOW_v2.pdf (updated)

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-minute call on Friday to walk through the two options and align on preferred path and the acceptance criteria for the pilot? If you prefer, procurement can mark up the SOW and we’ll take redlines.

Best,
